scope: XML character predicates, strict UTF-8 scalar decoding, and the bounded resumable lexical tag reader from xml_chars.c and xml_reader.c.

entries.adaptation: Returns decoded scalar and next offset together; None leaves caller state unchanged, matching C's unchanged position/output on failure without pointer mutation. Rejects overlongs, surrogates, bad continuations, truncation, and values above U+10FFFF.
Rust borrows immutable input for the reader lifetime and uses Result instead of an allocated opaque pointer/out-parameter. Source length above 1 GiB returns ReaderStatus::Limit.
Closure replaces C callback/context pair. ReaderTag spans use shared vexel_base::Span with exclusive end rather than offset/length; they slice the unchanged borrowed source.
Rust ownership releases scanner state automatically; no explicit destroy function is needed.
C token kinds map to TagKind::{StartElement, EndElement, EmptyElement}; diagnostics retain the C error categories and byte offsets.
Private state is ported because the public reader shares its quote/comment/PI/internal-subset scanning behavior; it skips declarations and never expands entities.

supported_subset: XML 1.0 Char, NameStartChar, NameChar and XML whitespace predicates.
Strict UTF-8 scalar decoding with unchanged caller position on failure.
A borrowing lexical scanner for start, end and empty-element tags, quoted-attribute counting, comments, CDATA, processing instructions and a single pre-element DOCTYPE skip.
Byte-accurate source/name spans, callback cancellation diagnostic, progress reporting, 1 GiB source cap, nonzero step budget capped at 64 KiB, and 4096-byte lexical name cap.
limits: Reader is intentionally not a validating XML tokenizer: it does not check XML characters, UTF-8, name grammar, matching tags, attribute syntax, document roots, or text/entity validity.
Reader events can be delivered before later input is scanned; only ReaderStatus::Complete marks scanner completion.
DOCTYPE content is skipped, not interpreted; custom entities and external resources are not resolved.
Full tokenizer/stream/index, entity/numeric decoding, and namespace semantics are outside this order.
